additions.note: Efficient model for visual reasoning, computer use, coding, and writing. Available in Codex and ChatGPT Work for eligible plans and through the API as gpt-6.1-terra.

Apache-2.0 33B dense agent model for coding and professional tasks, released with a base checkpoint. The team describes it as a teacher for future smaller models; October 24 is the initial public weight upload.

Full-duplex speech-to-speech research model trained from human speech. Block demonstrated local inference and invited safety researchers for early access; public weights and an API were not established.

Apache-2.0 vision-language family combining object-level detection, counting and OCR with pixel-level segmentation and matting. The research report appeared October 22; the 2B weights and model card were published October 23.

Apache-2.0 embodied model combining a language reasoner and video generator for interleaved visual planning. The initial public base weights were uploaded October 22; the research announcement followed October 23.

MIT-licensed weights for the medicine-focused Ling-3.0-flash-Sante, previously available as a hosted model. Initial weight upload was October 19 UTC; the model card was updated October 22. Research model, not a medical device.
